ValidationRule.description: Enforces data integrity by requiring the Rescinded Reason field when the School Application Status is set to Withdrawn/Declined, Offer Rescinded due to Seat Optimization, or Rescinded. Prevents saving incomplete withdrawal records.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(ISCHANGED( Status ) , OR( AND ( ISPICKVAL( Status , "Withdrawn/Declined"), ISPICKVAL(Withdrawn_Declined_Reason_Picklist__c, "" )),
AND( ISPICKVAL(Status , "Rescinded"), ISBLANK( Rescinded_Reason__c)) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Withdraw/Rescind Reason is required when the Status is set to a withdrawal status.
